label: Order
caption: DEPARTMENT OF JUSTICE V. HOUSE COMMITTEE ON THE JUDICIARY
text: UPON CONSIDERATION of the application of counsel for the applicant, IT IS ORDERED that the mandate of the United States Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia Circuit, case No. 19-5288, is hereby stayed pending receipt of a response, due on or before Monday, May 18, 2020, by 3 p.m. ET, and further order of the undersigned or of the Court.
